<BLOCK>text[145, 204, 858, 285]<FORK>Smart Engines scientists today announced a new generation of Smart Document Engine for instant and precise recognition of various documents and forms. <BLOCK>text[145, 301, 869, 381]<FORK>With the new mode, the Smart Document Engine user can instantly digitize any documents and hardcopies. Prior to that, for this purpose, they had to use a conventional flatbed scanner. Now all they have to do is put the correct document on the smartphone camera. The Smart Document Engine detects the document, recognises it, even if the paper is bent or damaged, and then displays the recognition results in a separate window.
<BLOCK>text[145, 397, 837, 446]<FORK>“We can confidently state that scanners will be part of the past very soon. <BLOCK>text[145, 461, 863, 526]<FORK>Compared to the earlier version, Smart Document Engine gives the user new tools to monitor recognition results. The system displays the coordinates of all text objects in the image and other supporting information. For example, the degree of recognition confidence in a text string, a word, or each individual character. By using this data, the system user can further analyze the recognition result.
<BLOCK>text[145, 541, 861, 588]<FORK>So, Smart Document Engine helps businesses not only to optimize the document entry processes, but also to solve other problems such as, for instance, finding documents in real time by keywords or creating electronic archives.

<BLOCK>text[144, 684, 828, 734]<FORK>The system supports recognition of documents in 20 languages, including English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Polish, Swedish, Czech, Croatian, Serbian, Bulgarian, Kazakh, Cyrillic and Latin, Generalized Latin, Turkish, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Arabic and Hebrew.

<PAGE><BLOCK>title<LEVEL1>[85, 64, 593, 93]<FORK>Annual Maintenance Report 2025
<BLOCK>text[82, 119, 905, 219]<FORK>The northern pumping station completed its scheduled maintenance in October. Engineers replaced two worn impellers, recalibrated the flow sensors and installed a new backup generator. The station was offline for nine days, which was two days shorter than planned.
<BLOCK>text[82, 236, 862, 309]<FORK>Water quality remained within all regulatory limits during the work. Temporary supply was provided from the eastern reservoir, and no customer reported an interruption of service.
<BLOCK>text[82, 327, 915, 400]<FORK>For the coming year the team recommends replacing the control software, which is no longer supported by its vendor, and adding remote monitoring to the three smaller stations in the valley.

<PAGE><BLOCK>title<LEVEL1>[85, 64, 496, 91]<FORK>Notes on Urban Gardens
<BLOCK>text[82, 118, 468, 295]<FORK>Community gardens have spread quickly through older neighbourhoods. Many began on empty lots that had been fenced off for years, and residents simply asked the owners for permission to plant.
<BLOCK>text[82, 312, 456, 461]<FORK>The first harvests were small, but the gardens soon became meeting places. Older residents taught younger ones how to prepare soil, save seeds and protect seedlings from late frost.
<BLOCK>text[518, 118, 912, 269]<FORK>City planners now include garden space in new housing projects. They argue that a shared garden costs little to maintain and gives people a reason to spend time outdoors with their neighbours.
<BLOCK>text[518, 286, 900, 438]<FORK>Critics point out that some gardens are used only by a few families. Successful projects usually have a small committee, clear rules for each plot and an open day for visitors every month.
